method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME. The chosen corridor is lettered vertically 'AVENUE P' inside its own roadway on BOTH sheets. WIDTH AND REPEATED READS. Sheet 26 block-face lines, read on all three block rows: 18TH-19TH 1061.5/1274.0, 19TH-20TH 1061.3/1272.8, 20TH-21ST 1063.4/1274.9 -> centres 1167.8, 1167.1, 1169.2, mean 1168.0, faces 211-213 px apart. Sheet 47: 21ST-22ND 1082.0/1292.5, 22ND-23RD 1078.4/1289.9, 23RD-24TH 1075.1/1287.2 -> centres 1187.3, 1184.2, 1181.2, mean 1184.2, faces 210-212 px apart. 70 ft = ~212 px on these plates, so both are full avenues and not the ~20 ft mid-block alleys. ADDRESS RUNS ACROSS THE LINE. Sheet 26, along 19TH ST: west of the line '1814 1816 1818 1820 1822 1824' and '1813 1815 1817 1819 1821 1823' (1800 block); east of it '1902 1904 1906' and '1901 1903 1905 1907 1909 1911' (1900 block). Sheet 47, along 22ND ST: west '1814 1816 1818 1820 1822 1824' and '1813 1815 1817 1819 1821 1823' (1800 block); east '1902 1904 ... 1912 | 1914 1916 ... 1924' and '1901 1903 ... 1911 | 1913 ... 1923' (1900 block). The identical 1800/1900 change occurs across this corridor on both sheets. THE AVENUE'S OWN FRONTAGE NUMBERS. Sheet 26 reads 1910-1926 even on the west face and 1909-1925 odd on the east face (the 19TH-20TH block of Ave P), with 1828/1827 in the row above; sheet 47 reads 2208-2226 even and 2207-2225 odd (the 22ND-23RD block), with 2128/2127 in the row above. Sheet 26 covers 17TH-21ST and sheet 47 covers 21ST-24TH, so 18xx/19xx/20xx and 21xx/22xx/23xx are consecutive blocks of one continuous Avenue P address sequence running west. CITY BLOCK NUMBERS AGREE. The half-column immediately west of the line is outlot quarters 70/69 on sheet 26 and 68/67 on sheet 47 (the Ave O 1/2 - Ave P half of the O-P outlot column); immediately east is 95/94 on sheet 26 and 93/92 on sheet 47 (the Ave P - Ave P 1/2 half of the P-Q column). Avenue P is the outlot-column boundary on both plates. ONE BLOCK WEST is excluded: that corridor is Avenue O 1/2, the western limit of coverage on BOTH sheets (east face 267.2 on sheet 26; faces 70.5/282.1, centre 176.3, on sheet 47). It bounds the WEST end of the 1800 run, and on the neighbouring sheet 46 the column west of it reads 17xx - so it carries the 1700/1800 change, not 1800/1900. Both key maps confirm the same framing: sheet 26 and sheet 47 key-map rectangles both begin at x=3400, so neither plate is shifted a block relative to the other. ONE BLOCK EAST is excluded: that corridor is lettered 'AVENUE P 1/2' on sheet 47 (faces 2090.1/2303.3, centre 2196.7, ~1013 px east of the reported line) and carries the 1900/2000 change. On sheet 26 Avenue P 1/2 is not opened at all across outlot 94 (Hotel Galvez and the unbuilt beach land): along 21ST ST the frontage numbers run continuously '1920 1922 1924 1926 1928 1930 2002 2004 2006 2008 2010' at even ~65 px spacing with NO roadway gap, so the 1900/2000 rollover falls on an unopened platted line near 2260 rather than on a corridor. Either way P 1/2 cannot be the shared line. INSET TRAP EXPLICITLY REJECTED. Sheet 26's upper-right corner carries a DETACHED INSET drawn in the Gulf space - outlot quarters S.W. 71 and S.E. 70, 16TH-18TH ST - which is lettered 'AVENUE O 1/2' with faces at 2010.3/2225.6 (native x ~2118). That lettered avenue is NOT on this sheet's own avenue lattice; it is a displaced fragment. It sits within ~80 px of sheet 47's Avenue P 1/2 (2196.7), so a name-plus-nearest-x match would have tied sheet 26's inset Ave O 1/2 to sheet 47's Ave P 1/2 - two avenues one full block apart and neither of them in the main map's frame. It is excluded because it lies beyond the heavy inset divider line at 2010 and its streets (16TH-18TH) are not in sheet 26's key-map coverage. CANDIDATES REJECTED. None of the six proposed candidates is the avenue: sheet 26's 764/1770/2776 and sheet 47's 574/1585/2596 land in block interiors and mid-block alleys. The values reported here are ruler-read avenue centres, not candidates. CROSS-CHECK. Two independently measured corridors give the same sheet26->sheet47 x offset: Ave P centre +16.2 and Ave O 1/2 east face +14.9 (spread 1.3 px), against ~1013 px for a one-block error.
